page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores and 4 vCPUs, providing 32.0 GB of system memory, which equates to an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.se1ne.xlarge exhibits modest processing capabilities. In CPU tests, the instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 920.0 and a multi-core score of 1996.0, placing its compute performance in the lower tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 163.7 GB/sec, which drops to 19.6 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Database operations, such as Redis SET, reached 2.83 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput was measured at 2.28 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its high memory allocation paired with relatively low CPU performance. This resource density profile makes it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not demand high-frequency compute power. It is suitable for hosting small-to-medium caching layers, lightweight database instances, or memory-intensive background processes where CPU utilization remains low.
